reviews.title: Auto click ads

reviews.title: Terrible App, Use The Web
reviews.text:
tl;dr Once you’ve performed one search, changing the price or year settings does not update the search. You must start over. Frustrating.

I don’t know if there’s some kind of trick to get the filters to work, but try as I might, the app ignores the price and year settings consistently. I put a price in of, say, 80,0000, then sort by price, and I’ve got 400K cars listed at the top. Doesn’t happen on the web. I loved this app at first but as time has gone by it’s gotten worse and worse with setting the filters. It’s just unusable now for finding the car you actually want.

reviews.title: Filters are useless
reviews.text: Used to be ok but last year or so the year & trim filtering makes searching here a waste of time — and if you’re gonna be an app dedicated to providing help finding vehicles you need useful sub filtering that can help you narrow down what you want since many people are shopping further away

reviews.title: Can’t open it
reviews.text: Every time I try to open it, it force closes. It’s up to date, my SW is up to date, there’s no reason for it to not work considering they supposedly just updated the app, I believe today… Based on experience & other recent reviews, the app needs more than a minor bug fix. Oh well, there’s plenty more out there & this is 1 less app to be overwhelmed from. Chat GTB lied, lol. Perhaps their website is better.
